chunks.text: ApexCloud is an intelligent enterprise cloud collaboration and workflow automation platform. We provide four transparent pricing tiers tailored to growing teams and global organizations.

- Price: $0 / month forever
- Users: Up to 3 team members
- Storage: 10 GB secure cloud storage
- Features: Basic workflow boards, community forum support, standard SSL encryption.
- Limitations: No API access, no custom domain, no phone or live chat support.

- Price: $29 per user / month (or $24 per user / month billed annually - save 17%)
- Users: 4 to 25 team members
- Storage: 500 GB pooled storage
- Features: Real-time document collaboration, unlimited workflow automation pipelines, REST API access (rate limit 1,000 requests/minute), 99.9% uptime SLA.
- Support: Standard email and live chatbot support with a guaranteed 12-hour response time.

- Price: $79 per user / month (or $65 per user / month billed annually - save 18%)
- Users: 26 to 100 team members
- Storage: 2 TB high-speed cloud storage
- Features: Advanced analytics and audit logs, Single Sign-On (SSO via Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD), custom branding, unlimited integrations.
- Support: Priority email and live chat support with a guaranteed 2-hour response time during business hours.

- Price: $199 per user / month (minimum 50 seats, billed annually)
- Users: Unlimited team members
- Storage: Unlimited distributed storage
- Features: Dedicated private cloud instance, custom data residency (US, EU, APAC), 99.99% financially backed uptime SLA, customized security controls.
- Support: 24/7/365 dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM), direct phone access, 15-minute response time SLA for critical incidents.
ApexCloud accepts all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, ACH wire transfers (for annual plans exceeding $5,000), and purchase orders. We bill in USD, EUR, GBP, and INR.

ApexCloud offers a full, no-questions-asked 30-day money-back guarantee for all first-time purchases of Annual Pro and Annual Business plans. If you are not completely satisfied within the first 30 days of initial purchase, contact support@apexcloud.io or trigger a human support ticket to receive a 100% refund.

Monthly subscriptions may be cancelled at any time through the Billing Settings page. 
- When you cancel a monthly subscription, cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.
- You will retain full access to your account and data until the current cycle expires.
- We do NOT issue prorated refunds for partial months or unused days within an active monthly subscription cycle.

Annual subscriptions renew automatically on their anniversary date.
- ApexCloud sends automated email reminders 30 days and 7 days prior to renewal.
- Customers may cancel auto-renewal at any time before the billing renewal date without penalty.
- Refunds for annual renewals requested within 7 calendar days of renewal will be granted with a 10% administrative processing fee. After 7 calendar days, no refunds will be issued for annual renewals.

Enterprise contracts are governed by their specific Master Services Agreement (MSA). 
- Enterprise agreements require a written cancellation notice at least 60 calendar days prior to contract renewal.
- Early termination fees may apply as stipulated in Section 8.4 of the Enterprise MSA.

If you downgrade from a higher tier to a lower tier:
- The downgrade takes effect at the next renewal cycle.
- If your account exceeds the storage quota of the lower tier (e.g. 500 GB on Pro vs 10 GB on Starter), you will have a 14-day grace period to download or remove excess data. After 14 days, files exceeding the quota will be read-only.

We strongly urge customers to contact our support team before initiating a chargeback with their bank or credit card provider. Accounts with open dispute claims will be temporarily frozen pending investigation.

- **SOC 2 Type II**: ApexCloud is audited annually by independent AICPA-accredited auditors. Our SOC 2 Type II report covering Security, Confidentiality, and Availability is available to customers under NDA upon request.
- **ISO 27001:2022**: Certified across all engineering, infrastructure, and operational locations.
- **GDPR & CCPA**: Fully compliant. We offer standard Data Processing Addendums (DPA) with standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for cross-border data transfers.

Processing Addendums (DPA) with standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for cross-border data transfers.
- **HIPAA**: HIPAA compliance and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) are available exclusively for Business and Enterprise tier subscribers.

- **Encryption in Transit**: All communications with ApexCloud services are enforced over TLS 1.3 with forward secrecy. Deprecated protocols (TLS 1.0, 1.1) are rejected.
- **Encryption at Rest**: Customer databases, file uploads, and vector search embeddings are encrypted using AES-256 bit encryption keys managed through AWS KMS with automatic annual key rotation.
- **Customer Managed Keys (BYOK)**: Available on the Enterprise tier, enabling customers to manage encryption keys in their own AWS KMS or HashiCorp Vault.

Customers can designate where their primary data and backups reside:
- US-East (Northern Virginia)
- US-West (Oregon)
- EU-Central (Frankfurt, Germany - GDPR localized)
- APAC (Singapore)

Data never leaves the chosen jurisdiction without explicit administrative authorization.

- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Supports TOTP (Google Authenticator, Authy) and FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys (YubiKey). Enforceable across organization-wide policies.
- Single Sign-On (SSO): Native SAML 2.0 and OIDC integrations supporting Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, Google Workspace, Ping Identity, and OneLogin.
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Four default roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Guest) plus custom role creation on Business and Enterprise tiers.

ApexCloud conducts continuous automated static and dynamic code scanning (SAST/DAST) and contracts with CREST-certified penetration testers biannually. We run an active private bug bounty program on HackerOne.
